spanish: Todas las ciudades que darán a los levitas cuarenta y ocho ciudad, a ellas y a sus ejidos.

findings.issue: תִּתְּנוּ is qal imperfect 2nd masculine plural: the addressees give the cities. In “las ciudades que darán”, “que” is the subject and agrees with “ciudades”, so the cities are the ones who give. The 2mp addressees become a different third party.
מִגְרְשֵׁיהֶן is only a masculine plural common noun with a 3fp suffix. The packet does not define the noun; “ejidos” names a specific communal land tenure.

notes: Cuarenta y ocho ciudad matches the singular עִיר after forty-eight; a ellas matches the 3fp object suffix.
